title: Doomsday Zombie Rush
description: Hold the highway barricade against relentless zombie waves—collect loot, unlock automated gun turrets, expand your safe zone, and blast through escalating hordes.
controls: Drag on screen with the virtual joystick to move your survivor, auto-fire at approaching zombies, gather cash drops, and step onto pads to build turrets and upgrades.

zh-CN.title: 末日打僵尸
zh-CN.description: 超爽末日尸潮割草防线：端枪走位扫射满屏僵尸、捡钞票建自动炮台、解锁火力升级，在尸潮围攻下守住公路据点！
zh-CN.controls: 按住屏幕拖动虚拟摇杆控制角色移动与走位射击，收集掉落金币踩上解锁区建造炮台与升级装备。
